verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this capability. Vapi stores call recordings and lets organizations control how recordings and logs are stored (vapi-docs-55), and calls can be managed programmatically via the CLI and the official MCP server that exposes Vapi APIs (vapi-docs-2, vapi-docs-33). No cited item explicitly documents retrieving recordings or transcripts. Missing for 10: documented API/SDK endpoint for fetching recording files or URLs, transcript retrieval, end-of-call webhook payloads with recording/transcript, confirmation of coverage for every call, independent or hands-on corroboration.
